race.comment: Great race to finish but sticking with the tough MAGIC DEFENSE (1). Won the Alice Springs Cup three back, then back to 1300m was no match for Dakota Lee but stretching out to the mile last time lifted strongly enough to turn the tables on her. In great form and should go close. KOMACHI (2) was three lengths away in that race but that was only after a poor start and having too much to do late. Made good ground and gets a chance to finish closer. REMATCH (8) was a good winner latest at this trip and can go on with it. CROWN WATERS (11) was only 1.5 lengths from MAGIC DEFENSE and has to be included. THE GIRL'S BOY (10) was an easy winner latest and looks as though she will run the mile.
